description: D74 follow-up: control, strengthened, paired against lstm_balance_v2p_priority_strong_seed2. Identical in every respect except priority_uniform=True -- band_priority stays all-ones every episode, so both the discovery and occupancy terms still fire at the same scale but carry no differential. Isolates whether any treatment-arm effect comes from reading band_priority vs. the larger reward scale both stronger terms add uniformly. Same LSTM hidden size (512) and timesteps (800k) as the treatment arm.
